A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DeNVeR research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original XACV segmentation measurements, CADICA qualitative evaluations, component ablations, and appendix analyses of temporal coherence, priors, and hyperparameter sensitivity.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative and qualitative results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The two-stage DeNVeR procedure, Hessian/RAFT preprocessing, neural representations, B-spline/Eulerian motion modeling, and training losses are unchanged. The appendix architectures also match.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same XACV dataset of 111 sequences from 59 patients and provide qualitative CADICA comparisons. v3's newly mentioned five-sequence supplementary sample concerns access information, not additional evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Hessian, U-Net, SSVS, DARL, and FreeCOS. Corresponding CADICA comparisons and appendix comparisons with image-input and video-input U-Net also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: The 8:2 split, thresholding and region growing, evaluation metrics, training settings, and five-frame supervised comparison are retained. v3 newly explains that other weights remain fixed during the existing sensitivity analysis, without reporting a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The component ablations, FreeCOS-prior substitution, temporal-coherence analysis, and hyperparameter sweeps are retained. v2 Appendix A.5/Figure 14 becomes v3 Section 4.5/Figure 10 with the same plots; the additional visualization panels are redistributed rather than added.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same uncertainty reporting in Table 1. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All 42 mean/uncertainty pairs in Table 1 and all numerical entries in Table 2 match. Figure 6 retains DeNVeR AUROC 0.83 and AUPRC 0.78; the qualitative examples, sensitivity curves, and reported 2.5% Dice improvement from substituting the prior are also retained.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7 and the assumption that vessel topology remains unchanged during a short clip are retained. No mathematical definitions, derivations, or proofs are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The central claims about unsupervised test-time vessel segmentation, temporal coherence, adaptability, and the first labeled XACV dataset remain. Removing the abstract's promotional closing sentences does not materially change the contribution scope.

C2.justification: The Introduction adds an explicit explanation linking connectivity and smooth-deformation violations to physiologically implausible segmentations, while dropping the discussion of ambiguity from projecting 3D vessels into 2D. Result interpretations and the stated limitations concerning preprocessing, runtime, and contrast-flow applicability otherwise remain.

D1.justification: v3 Section 4.1 and Appendix A newly state that five XACV sequences and source code are included in supplementary material/a zip file; v2 provided an example link and promised dataset release. v3 also clarifies the fixed-other-weights sensitivity procedure. These are documentation changes; the PDFs do not verify the supplementary package itself.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive related-work positioning are retained, including the relationship to Deformable Sprites in Section 2. Numerical citations replace author-year citations, with bibliographic formatting changes.

P1.justification: The Introduction is rewritten around four explicit challenges, and the abstract and limitations are shortened. The sensitivity discussion moves into Section 4.5 and appendix headings are reorganized, while most method and experiment prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: The document changes from single-column to two-column layout, extensively resizing and relocating figures and tables. v2 Figures 10–11 are redistributed across v3 Figures 11–13, sensitivity plots move into the main text, and temporal/prior visualizations occupy separate appendix pages. These are substantial display changes to retained evidence.

improvement.justification: v3 organizes the motivation more clearly, integrates existing sensitivity evidence into the ablation discussion, and improves supplementary code/data disclosure. Enlarged appendix comparisons aid inspection, although several other figures become smaller. These are limited presentation and documentation gains; the scientific evidence and principal methodological limitations remain unchanged.
